Thunder Totem Stolen Goods are found in a cave in Pinerock Basin in Highmountain after defeating Arru.
Throne of Stonemaul is located in Kor'gall's Hovel in Gorgrond. It is the seat of power for and the .
Thrumming Powerstone has chance to drop a random lattice when disenchanted by a character with the enchanting profession.
Three of Putrescence is a reagent for Darkmoon Deck: Putrescence.
Three of the Indomitable is a reagent for the Darkmoon Deck: Indomitable.
The Throw Net is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Dragonskull Shoal *Dragonsprings Drop *Flying Fish *Highland Habitat *Hot Stock *Subglacial Refill

The Thunderhorn Water Well is located in the midst of the grasslands in Mulgore, by the north road between Thunder Bluff and Bloodhoof Village. This well had been taken over by the Venture Company in order to control the water supply but were run off by the tauren. Shortly before the Cataclysm, the well was destroyed by a turmoil of the elements. The tauren shaman Muln Earthfury and the Earthen Ring tried to stop the disaster by asking help from the elements, in vain, until the mysterious Shotoa achieved this by forcing the elements to obey him. The Thuzadin were a group of necromancers and dark wizards operating in the burning city of Stratholme, headquarters of the Scourge in Lordaeron. They guarded the Ash'ari Crystals in the ziggurats as part of the Cult of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Thurman Schneider is a human child found in Larson Clothiers in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
Thuron's Livery is located just east of the entrance to Silvermoon in Eversong Woods. It is where Horde adventurers can buy hawkstriders.

Thurg is found in Zul'Aman as one of the eight possible adds for Hex Lord Malacrass. An ogre melee. Sap, trap or polymorph can be used. Thurg has some magic resistance and will often break polymorph and traps early.

Thunk's Abode is a camp in northeastern Desolace, northeast of the Cenarion Wildlands and south of Sargeron. Cenarion Embassador Thunk has set up here under Cenarion Circle's orders to turn the barren surrounding land into prairie. Thunk's Wyvern acts as a flight master.
Ticky the Alchemist is a goblin alchemy vendor locked in the same cage as Jorgensen at Render's Camp in the Redridge Mountains.

Thunderfoot Pigs are pigs located at Thunderfoot Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds. Occasionally, they wander into the mud. A couple of dead ones are found next to Ba'kon in the Golden Terrace in the Shrine of Two Moons.
Thunk's Wyvern is a wyvern flight master located at Thunk's Abode in Desolace.
Tic Tak is a hozen found with on a small island at the center of the north shore of Kun-Lai Summit.
Tian Disciple is a pandaren found during the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
Tian Mistweaver is a pandaren found during the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
Thunderlord Sky Riders are orcs flying on Thunderlord War Rylaks in the Bones of Agurak in Frostfire Ridge.
Thyllera Moonleaf is a night elf found at the Grove of Aessina on Mount Hyjal.

The Thundering Terrace lies at the foot of Skycallers' Spire in northern Vol'dun. Without flying, the terrace is only reachable by traversing a large bridge spanning the Slithering Gulch. A huge stair in the center of the terrace leads up to the main Skycallers' Spire area. The terrace's western end is mainly reserved for young Faithless fighters to train their skills, while aspiring skycallers do the same in the eastern end.
Thunderhawk Devourer is a wind serpents located in Island Expeditions.
Thundershock is an lightning elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Thundersnort the Loud is a boar located in Island Expeditions.
Thundering Roar is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Thundering is the Dragonflight Season 1 affix for Mythic+. It is applied as a seasonal 4th affix that is added to every Mythic Keystone at level 10 or higher. Every 60 seconds in combat, all players will receive either Mark of Lightning or Mark of Wind. Both marks will increase damage and healing by 30%, and make you immune to roots and slows, for 15 seconds. If the mark expires while another player has the opposite mark, it will cause an overload. Overloaded players are stunned and take nature damage every second for 5 seconds. Touching a player with the opposite mark will remove both of them without causing an overload.
Thunderstorms in Thaldraszus is a expansion features achievement earned for defeating creatures empowered by elemental air in Thaldraszus during a Primal Storm.
Thunderstorms in The Azure Span is a expansion features achievement earned for defeating creatures empowered by elemental air in the Azure Span during a Primal Storm.
Thunderstorms in the Ohn'ahran Plains is a expansion features achievement earned for defeating creatures empowered by elemental air in the Ohn'ahran Plains during a Primal Storm.
Thunderstorms in The Waking Shores is a expansion features achievement earned for defeating creatures empowered by elemental air in the Waking Shores during a Primal Storm.
Tidal Defenders are water elementals found in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Thunderspine Nest is crafted by Erugosa at the Roasted Ram inn of Valdrakken for players on the second day of Secrets of Azeroth activities. Speak with Erugosa to acquire the Thunderspine Nest Shopping List: She needs: * 5x Apexis Asiago from Gorgonzormu at in the Artisan's Market, Valdrakken * 5x Thunderspine Tenders from Agurahl the Butcher at in the Timberstep Outpost, Ohn'ahran Plains * 5x Latticed Stinkhorn from Sniktak at in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern Speak with Erugosa after acquiring the ingredients: She crafts a stack of ten. Take them to Clinkyclick Shatterboom, the engineering trainer located at outside the PvP room in the Obsidian Enclave and trade her some food for the Thought Calcul

Tiger's Fury is a Feral druid talent. It is a Cat Form buff that restores 20 Energy and gives a brief increase in damage. It does not break Prowl and does not trigger the global cooldown. At 0 energy cost, using this before any ability is a DPS gain.

__NOTOC__ Tideress is a corrupted water elemental found on an island in the center of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. Mastok Wrilehiss is concerned about the corruption of Mystral Lake, and is interested in the water globe that Tideress drops.

Tidefury Cove is located at the end of Dustwallow Bay, south of Theramore Isle and off the coast of the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. It is dotted with small islands and reefs, and is a perilous place to steer one's ships. Two ships are currently found broken upon the shallows here, now riddled with roaming makrura. The famous fisherman Nat Pagle also makes his home on Nat's Landing, one of the cove's many islets.

Tidelord Rrurgaz was a level 62 elite male naga found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.

Tides' Hollow is a damp cave occupied by the Wrathscale naga who also occupy the nearby Wrathscale Point ruins. The interior is filled with ruined night elf relics and columns, which suggests that a night elf settlement was once located here. According to Priestess Kyleen Il'dinare at Odesyus' Landing, Tides' Hollow and the surrounding ruins were once part of a night elven city. It is unknown why the night elves departed, but the naga eventually took over the ruins and cave system.

Tidal Wave is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Tiger Strikes is a passive monk ability, learned at level 10. It has a 10% chance to trigger while using a two-handed weapon, and a 5% chance to trigger while dual wielding.

__NOTOC__ Tiger Gourami have a high chance to be caught from Tiger Gourami Schools, which can be found in the Veiled Stair and the northern inland waters of Kun-Lai Summit. They also have a common chance to be caught when fishing in open water in the Veiled Stair or the mountainous regions of Kun-Lai Summit with high enough fishing skill. They are a cooking ingredient for a couple of recipes. They can also be purchased from Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds; one Ironpaw Token purchases a Sack of Tiger Gourami which contains five of them.
The Tidescuttler can be found on the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah.

Tideskorn Harbor is a vrykul harbor town found near the Helmouth Shallows in Stormheim. Formerly home to the Tideskorn clan, they earned their name the day the mists took their greatest harbor. Since then, no vrykul loyal to Odyn has willingly entered that cursed place. The final quest in this area requires players to complete the Maw of Souls, and destroy Helya's ship, the Naglfar.

The Tideskorn clan are the united vrykul tribes of Stormheim, led by a God-King. They include the Drekirjar, the Bonespeakers and the Valkyra. Both the leaders of the Drekirjar and the Bonespeakers thus have a claim to rule the Tideskorn. If female, the ruler is expected or assumed to be a member of the Valkyra. Their largest settlement is the city of Hrydshal, home of the dragon-taming Drekirjar. Those among the Tideskorn who accepted the fel gift and turned felsworn became known as Felskorn. They remained the same tribe, and shared the same banner.
Tidal Pools is a Restoration shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Empowered Droplets trait.
Tiger's Palm is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

The Tidesage Council are the leading council of the tidesages, beneath Lord Stormsong. It consists of Wavespeaker Reid, Brother Ironhull and Galecaller Faye. Each member oversees a different aspect of the tidesage order's work. Reid trained initiates in the oldest form of tidesage magic, communing with the sea. He was killed by the Storm's Wake after he, like many, took up the Void. The remaining members of the Council are the second boss encounter of the Shrine of the Storm dungeon.

Tide's Inn is the central inn, and largest building, of the Kul Tiran town of Hatherford. Sitting just outside the gates of Boralus, the establishment is owned and run by Dandy Jones, while its name is a pun referencing the cycle of ocean tides.
The Tidestone Vault Key drops from Elya Azuremoon in the Hall of Arcane Learning of Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna.

Tideguards are Kul Tiran human warriors operating in Stormsong Valley. They are members of the Storm's Wake, and use water magic like tidesages. In order to become a tideguard, one takes an oath. Veteran tideguards use the Rod of Tides as a key of sorts to maintain the Path of Storms across dangerous waters. Several of them sided with the traitorous Lord Stormsong and remained loyal to House Stormsong while others fought with the tidesages, and the Alliance emissary against the corrupt lord and his dark allies and forces.
Tide-Lost Champion is a kvaldir encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tide Lord Makuna is a naga lord who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tidemistress Najula is a naga who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tidemistress Nessa is a naga who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Tidemistress Sser'ah is a naga who can be encountered during Island Expeditions. She is accompanied by Shadow Serpents.
__NOTOC__ Tide Lord Szunis is a naga lord who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tidemistress Vessana is a naga who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tide-Cursed Mistresses are kvaldir who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Tidesage Menders are two humans located in Proudmoore Keep in Boralus. They are channeling magic into Mekkatorque's Escape Pod.

Tiganeous is a giant abomination roaming the northern end of the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus during the bombing run in Enemy at the Door. They can be damaged by Ragewing's abilities but do not grant any quest progress if killed.
__NOTOC__ Tidereaver Steelfang is a naga located in Island Expeditions.
Tiger and Crane Figurines is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tiger's Tenacity is a Feral druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Raging Fury.

This article compiles all the official timelines and sources published by Blizzard into a non-exhaustive timeline of recorded important events in the Warcraft universe. This should not be considered as an official timeline but should be as accurate as, and more complete than, any timeline that Blizzard has provided. Numbering in this timeline is based on the opening of the Dark Portal, as this is the method used by the official sources. All dates are considered to be spans of time from one to the next since many events are only given vague ordering and estimated dates. Warcraft products are displayed in italics.
Timbermaw Brawlers are a pair of Leatherworking-crafted gloves that give bonuses to Strength and Stamina.
Time Watchers are guardians of the Caverns of Time. They fly around the central hourglass but occasionally land to take on the form of Lordaeron human sentries.
Timeless Arrows were the most powerful type of arrows available in , adding 53 DPS (not counting Nether Spike that can only be used in one battle, and would then be considered the second best.)
Timeless Shells were the most powerful type of bullets available prior to .
Timber Worg Alphas are worgs located in Terokkar Forest, primarily south of Shattrath City and between Tuurem, Firewing Point, and Bonechewer Ruins.
Timber Worgs are worgs located in Terokkar Forest, found primarily southeast of Shattrath City.

Time anomalies are fluctuations in time often caused by outside sources. Bronze dragons keep track of time in order to prevent temporal incursions from happening. A strange time anomaly surfaced during the War of the Ancients and nearly unmade creation. It sent Broxigar, Rhonin, and Krasus back in time. It may have been influenced through the desires of sleeping Old Gods who wish to be free at any cost. Several tunnels in the Caverns of Time lead to time anomalies caused by the infinite dragonflight.
Timbermaw Warders are furbolgs located at Timbermaw Hold in Felwood and Moonglade. Killing them reduces your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction.
Time Warp is a level 49 mage ability. This is a bloodlust effect.
Tilly Topspin is a gnome flight master located on Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles. Zazzix Boomride is her Horde counterpart.

Cook 10,000 Cataclysm cooking recipes. Note that not all Cataclysm recipes count towards this achievement. Recipes that no longer count for this achievement (this list may be incomplete, see Set the Oven to "Cataclysmic" for details): * Chocolate Cookie * Darkbrew Lager * Feathered Lure * Highland Spirits * Kungaloosh * Conjured Mana Biscuit * South Island Iced Tea * Starfire Espresso
Time is Money is a passive racial ability for all goblins, increasing haste.

The Timeless Eye is created with the aid of the adventurers to test their worthiness to Anachronos, and to provide an essential tool in the unraveling of the mystery of the destruction of Azeroth. It is created with Eternal Embers, Sands of Time (alchemy) and ancient magics weaved by Anachronos. Later, the Eye was placed in the Nether Vortex at the Rift of the Nexus and unveiled a mysterious event showing a meeting between Deathwing and Arygos.
Time-Twisted Seers are Black Dragonflight dragonspawns in the Obsidian Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Breakers are Black Dragonflight dragonspawns in the Obsidian Dragonshrine in End Time.
Time-Twisted Drakes are Black Dragonflight drakes in the Obsidian Dragonshrine in End Time.

Time Transit Devices are transportation objects found in the latest Caverns of Time instances. Unlike past teleportation devices, these can only be used one player at a time, and will have it's portal vanish for a second while it transports a player. This causes groups of players to wait while they'll move across the zone.
Time Off was a planned Guild Perk that increased the rest bonus players receive while offline or in a city/inn. This perk would have been gained at guild level 27.

A true enigma, the Timeless Isle has drifted in and out of Pandaria's mists for hundreds of years. Here, time has no meaning, and the sun neither rises nor sets. Its unique characteristics have brought the Isle under the scrutiny of the bronze dragonflight, pandaren explorers, and the black dragon Wrathion. The Timeless Isle is a level 30-35 PvE zone located to the east of the Jade Forest. Seek the Isle alone or in a group to collect Timeless Coins (which will allow players to purchase unique gear from the locals) or to do battle with massive creatures and dangerous world bosses. Among the latter are Ordos, the lost Yaungol fire god; and the four August Celestials, who stand ready to test th
The Time-Lost Waters is the water that joins the Timeless Isle in its transitions through time. It merges back into the South Seas when the island appears.

__NOTOC__ The Time-Lost Glade is a forested wetland high in the mountains of . It is where Garrosh Hellscream betrayed and killed Kairoz and took his fragment of the Vision of Time. Kairoz's death left the immediate area temporally unstable, allowing several Time-Lost creatures - including the Gordunni ogres that populate the area in Outland - to come into the glade. During Tarnished Bronze, Chromie leads Khadgar and the commander to the glade to put Kairoz's spirit to rest.
Time is a Flat Circle is a feat of strength achievement earned for defeating Archimonde on Normal difficulty or higher, prior to the release of the next tier content.
Time Stop is an ability used by Ageless Bronze Drake during a Pet Battle.

The Time-Lost Dragon Rider was a vrykul ghost who acted as flight master at Valdisdall in Stormheim.

Timebreaker's Paradox is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Time Rifts are the major open-world feature of patch 10.1.5. Taking place in the Tyrhold Reservoir of central Thaldraszus at the top of each hour, players are tasked with killing enemies and completing minigames on behalf of the bronze dragonflight. When the scenario begins, speak with Soridormi at to sign up and instantly load into the Time Rifts phase. Then follow the objective tracker to complete the assigned tasks. As players defeat the requested enemies or finish tasks, they will gain standing with Soridormi's friendship faction, earn Paracausal Flakes, and Temporal Essence points. Tinker Town (also spelled Tinkertown) is the gnomish quarter of Ironforge. It is home to a number of alchemy and engineering trainers, as well as the entrance to the famed Deeprun Tram. When the gnomes lost Gnomeregan to the troggs, the dwarves of Ironforge took in the refugees. The gnomes constructed Tinker Town in the district where the Ironforge Deeprun Tram station had been built. Some dwarves like Skuerto were booted out of the city to make way for them, implying dwarves originally lived in this ward. Prior to the partial retake of Gnomeregan, Tinker Town was the center of the gnomish court in exile and High Tinker Mekkatorque could be found here, along with his closest advisers.

, Timmy, Arthas]] Timmy is a neutral ghoul encountered by Prince Arthas and Jaina Proudmoore in Andorhal in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos during Chapter Four of the Human Campaign called "Cult of the Damned". Timmy is kept in a cage at the center of Andorhal and can be freed by destroying it. Timmy is a Neutral being, so he can only be attacked with the Attack-button and then a Left-click on him. He can be killed and drops the Ring of Superiority. Although his faction color is the same as the Undead Scourge, he is of the "Timmy" faction (which is, of course, not hostile to the player).

__NOTOC__ Tirisfal Farmhands are humans found wandering the Solliden Farmstead outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. They are persistent holdouts, refusing to leave their homes and farms despite the close proximity of the Undercity. Members of the Forsaken are often tasked with killing these last vestiges of the living in Lordaeron.
Tiny Bronze Key was a reagent of the unique mage ability Khadgar's Unlocking in beta versions of World of Warcraft. They were sold by reagent vendors.
Tiny Iron Key was a reagent of the unique mage ability Khadgar's Unlocking in beta versions of World of Warcraft. They were sold by reagent vendors.
Tiny Copper Key was a reagent of the unique mage ability Khadgar's Unlocking in beta versions of World of Warcraft. It did not make it to retail version.
Tiny Silver Key was a reagent of the unique mage ability Khadgar's Unlocking in beta versions of World of Warcraft. It did not make it to retail version.
Tinkerbell is Haris Pilton's wolf pet. He can be found accompanying her in the lower part of Shattrath City.
__NOTOC__ Timothy Cunningham is a Forsaken flight master located at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

__NOTOC__ Tirisfal Pink Elekks are see-through pink elekks found roaming the Ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity during Brewfest. They can only be seen when you are drunk.

The first tinker's arm was created by the Tinker's Guild in Ratchet for Samuel Wrenchwright, a popular member who lost a limb in an accident. When others saw that Wrenchwright had not only gained a useful limb but also increased strength, they asked the tinkers to develop a version that might be used without the loss of a living arm. The resulting apparatus is strapped to the wearer's arms.

Many tinkers may leave their workshops to go adventuring, but some bring their workshops with them in the form a tinker's belt. This heavy leather belt features a small phlogiston boiler to power devices, large pouches to carry parts and inventions-in-progress, hooks and straps to carry tools, and two articulated arms with hand-like clamps that can hold devices while the tinker works on them. While these "hands" must be manually positioned in place, tinkers have been known to use them as aids in climbing and other non-mechanical pursuits.

__NOTOC__ The Tiny Flamefly is a quest reward from: *SEVEN! YUP!, which begins with Oralius at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes. *Not Fireflies, Flameflies, which begins with Kibler at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

The tinker's tosser is yet another in a long line of mechanical arms, this one a sizeable model attached to a backpack containing its phlogiston power source. A hand mounted in the end of the arm can hold anything from a rock to a dagger, while crosshairs hanging in front of the wearer's eye allow him to select a target. Properly loaded and aimed, the tosser throws its payload at the target.
Tina Nguyen is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Tina Wang is a pandaren barmaid serving in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons.

Timewalking (colloquially referred to as Timewalker or Timewalker mode) is a dungeon difficulty added in patch 6.2.0 of Warlords of Draenor, allowing players to queue up for a randomly selected dungeon from a previous expansion. Timewalking difficulty scales down the character's power and gear relative to the dungeon. Loot obtained during this difficulty has the Timewarped tag, which scales up to an item level appropriate for use at the player's level. Timewalking is available for characters level 60 and up and requires a minimum item level of 180. Killing bosses in timewalking dungeons will award Timewarped Badges which can be traded for valuable items at the timewalking vendors.
Tinkrul is a drogbar drummer and a member of Hardrogg's band who occasionally appears in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain. As his name suggests, Tinkrul beats on "Tink Rocks".
The Tinted Cave is a cave located at Sparkweaver Point on Mechagon Island. The Crazed Trogg is rarely found in here.

Tirna Noch is a withered grove and dream tree in eastern Ardenweald. Ara'lon was the keeper of the wildseeds here, including that of Ursoc, before the Wild Hunt drained its last anima to preserve the forest. Afterward, Ara'lon joined the Wild Hunt. Nothing can be done to bring the tree, or the spirits within, back. During questing, the adventurer with the help of Niya and Ara'lon take its heart to Tirna Vaal. The grove is being claimed by both the Drust and briefly by Mueh'zala.

Timewalking Campaigns (aka Chromie Time) allow players who have already experienced Battle for Azeroth and reached level 60 on at least one character to choose to level any subsequent characters in a different expansion. While a Timewalking Campaign is active, all zones will scale up to level 60 instead of their usual level caps. Veteran players can pick a campaign from Chromie near the Stormwind Embassy or Orgrimmar Embassy and get adventuring. When a character reaches level 61, they will be removed from Timewalking Campaigns and teleported back to Stormwind or Orgrimmar. At level 60 characters are meant to progress into the Dragon Isles.
Tiny Iron Star is a quality trinket that can be activated to deal fire damage to an enemy.
The Tipsy Tinkerer is a bar located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Timeweaver's Needle is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Timeworn Dreambinder is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Timeworn Dreambinder.
Tiny Dancing Shoes is an anima power that can be chosen by healers and DPS after defeating Soggodon the Breaker in Mythic+ dungeons with the Tormented affix.

__NOTOC__ Tinsy Gleamsprocket is a gnome located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. She traveled to the Dragon Isles with Taravos where they both ended up in a Proto-dragon trap. Zorza freed them and lead them to the safety of the city.
Tiny Butterflies are butterfly critters found all over the Waking Shores.
Tiny Oozes are oozes located in the Wetlands. They land on the head of adventurers who are hit by the Ooze cap ability of Silty Oozelings.

Tirisfal may refer to: *Guardian of Tirisfal, a mortal champion empowered to secretly battle the Burning Legion. *Council of Tirisfal, the secret society that chose the Guardians of Tirisfal. **New Council of Tirisfal, the reborn same organization. *Tirisfal Glades, location of the ruined capital of the former kingdom of Lordaeron, and the place where the Council met. es:Tirisfal

Titan Panel is an interface AddOns which creates a horizontal bar where additional plugin modules can be deployed displaying all sorts of useful, at-a-glance, game data. Its growing in popularity because of its good looks, simplicity, and ease of creating plugins to be displayed within the panel. Version 4 supports a variety of different bar locations. They are: * 1 bar at the top * 1 bar at the bottom * 1 bar at the top and 1 bar at the bottom * 2 bars at the top * 2 bars at the bottom * 2 bars at the top and 1 bar at the bottom

Tiza Battleforge is a dwarf quest giver located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. She is one of the most respected paladins in the city and has been known to train aspiring paladins in the ways of the Light, putting them on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats, often through quests of charity and penance. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, Tiza joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. She later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
To'arch's Primers are primers designed in Area 52. They are using demon's power as an explosive. It requires four Demonic Rune Stones to activate.
"To Do Today" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
Titan's Grip is a passive level 11 Fury warrior ability. It allows a warrior to wield a two-handed weapon in one hand.
__NOTOC__ Titansteel Destroyer is created with Blacksmithing (440); taught by Blacksmithing trainers.
Titan-Forged Rune of Audacity is sold for 25 Wintergrasp Mark of Honor by * * These vendors are only present inside Wintergrasp Fortress when the corresponding faction controls the fortress.

Titan orbs are spheres of titan origin that are often found in titan-forged facilities. They have many uses, being able to serve among other things as sentries, defensive countermeasures, monitoring devices, databanks, etc. There are several titan-touched gathering nodes on the Dragon Isles with an orb flying over them.

This rogue-only quest is the fourth part of the chain to obtain the legendary dagger set Fangs of the Father. It is the first of several Stealth-based missions in the series. It also marks the end of the "prelude" to the storyline, revealing the power that has been influencing events so far.
Tivilix Bangalter is a goblin located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Tixit Brightfuse is a goblin vendor located in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Titan Keeper Hezrel was a titanic watcher who once watched over the Old God G'huun in Uldir, in Nazmir. Over time, he fell into misuse and was believed by the people of Nazmir to simply be an old statue. During the Fourth War, Hezrel was reactivated, and through him the Zandalari Princess Talanji learned of the titan complex and what it contained, before she went to investigate it with the Gob Squad. Hezrel led the Horde forces into the Underrot to destroy the Unbound Abomination and contain G'huun's corruption. Though the mission was successful, he was slain by the Abomination.
Titan Defenders are titan orbs located in Neltharion's Vault in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Titan Cores drop from Ra-den in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Tirnenn Villagers are located in the Oaken Assembly in the Mists of Tirna Scithe. Some have been enslaved by Drust magic and will stay hostile until weakened.
Tishereenelee is a tirnenn flight master located in Root-Home in Ardenweald.
Titanic Countermeasure is located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Tithing Dish is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tixxa Mixxa is a goblin flight master located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
Tishad is a draenei located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Tizzi Twistcog is a gnome located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.

__NOTOC__ Titan Training Matrix III is an optional crafting reagent that can be used in several Dragon Isles profession recipes to craft items equivalent to heroic-quality dungeon gear. It is dropped by the final boss of each of the 8 Dragonflight dungeons on heroic difficulty.

__NOTOC__ Titan Training Matrix IV is an optional crafting reagent that can be used in several Dragon Isles profession recipes to craft items equivalent to mythic-quality dungeon gear. It is dropped by the final boss of each of the 8 Dragonflight dungeons on mythic difficulty.
To Dragonbane Keep! is a breadcrumb quest for the Siege on Dragonbane Keep. Herald Flaps will fly over and offer this quest when you reach Renown level 5 with the Valdrakken Accord.
Titan-Touched Hochenblumes are Hochenblume herbs that are titan-touched, with an orb flying over them.

Titan Power Relays are found in the chambers connected to the four pillars at Tyrhold in Thaldraszus. The following components can be installed here: *Large Titan Capacitor *Titan Block Key *Titan Energy Cube *Titan Focusing Crystal

Tol Barad, pronounced (Tohl bar-AHD), is a ravaged island-prison located west of Gilneas.

The Tomb of the Ancients was the residence and final resting place of Lord Talendar, located in Dustwallow Marsh in Kalimdor. Though centuries of dust cover this lair, masterless golems still patrol its halls, defending long abandoned corridors and ancient artifacts of power. While he lived, Talendar was drawn to the arcane, even though he was unable to cast spells himself. He thus decided to surround himself with the arcane and locked himself within the halls which were to become his tomb. He was defended by a host of skeletons, golems, and salamanders, as well as the Mistress of Shadows and her Maidens of Shadows, some of whom were studying in an adjacent library. He was defeated by Rexxar
Token of Thievery is looted from Lucius's Lockbox in the Redridge Mountains.

Tome of Conjure Water drops from elites in most high-level Burning Crusade dungeons, such as Tempest Keep, Shattered Halls, parts of Auchindoun, The Steamvault, Caverns of Time, Karazhan and also in heroic dungeons. This tome, along with the Tome of Conjure Food VIII, was necessary to learn Ritual of Refreshment from Mage trainers. Right now it's useless.

Toasted Smorcs are a quest reward from the following Midsummer Fire Festival quests: *Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms *Flickering Flames in Kalimdor *Stealing Darnassus's Flame *Stealing the Undercity's Flame
The Tome of Dusk drops from Grand Warlock Nethekurse in The Shattered Halls on Heroic difficulty.

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Tome of Agility +2 |icon=INV_Misc_Book_08 |class=Power Up |level=2 |desc=Permanently increases Agility. }} Permanently increases the Agility of the Hero by 2 when used.

__NOTOC__ Tomb of Relics is a shop from which any unit that has an inventory window can purchase items. The items available are dependant upon what level of upgrade your necropolis has (Necropolis, Halls of the Dead, or Black Citadel) and what buildings you have. Heroes can also sell unwanted items to any item shop. The teleporters known as the Reliquary of Pain and Reliquary of Agony may be a reference to this structure.

Tol Ronal is the first mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness Shareware. This is an early version of the mission Zul'dare as seen in the retail game. It shares similar mission objectives, but the map design and mission briefing are different: in the retail game the Horde chooses to attack the kingdom of Lordaeron through the island of Zul'Dare rather than through Khaz Modan. In the retail game the Horde does not turn towards Khaz Modan until the second act.
Tobias Sarkhoff is a Forsaken flight master located at New Agamand in the Howling Fjord.

Tombs of the Precursors is a collection of tombs of different shapes and sizes found east of Nahom in Uldum. The sun priests of Nahom are tasked with watching over these tombs, however, recently the Neferset have begun looting and destroying relics held here. The looters' leader, Raider Lord Havat, is found just east of the tombs in Keset Pass. The Halls of Origination is found just south of here. The Tombs of the Precursors has been occupied by the Amathet, a group of tol'vir who believe only they can protect the titans' works. They are reassembling broken Uldum watchers found here.

Tol'vir Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Tol'vir archaeology sites.
Tol Barad Peninsula is the northernmost region of the island of Tol Barad and is a major daily quest hub in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm.

A Tol'vir Hieroglyphic is an archaeology keystone. It acts as 12 Tol'vir Archaeology Fragments in research on Tol'vir archaeology finds that have 'sockets'. They can also be used in Cataclysm dungeons to grant a group wide buff. The buffs available are: *Vortex Pinnacle: Grants Whisper of the Djinn, which heals your wounds and replenishes mana slowly *Lost City of the Tol'vir: Grants Tol'vir Secrets, a 10 percent bonus damage against the Neferset *Halls of Origination: Grants Map of the Architects, which increases movement speed
To the Ground! is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Commander Springvale without allowing him to receive Unholy Empowerment in Shadowfang Keep on Heroic difficulty.

Tol Barad quests take place in two sets of quest hubs, one on the northern Tol Barad Peninsula that always available, regardless of which faction controls Baradin Hold, and another on the southern, main Tol Barad island at Baradin Keep, which is available to the faction that controls it. Completing every single daily quest awards the achievement Just Another Day in Tol Barad, while completing 100 dailies awards the achievement Breaking Out of Tol Barad.
Tol'vir Merchants are tol'vir found in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

Tohfo Skyhoof is a tauren flying mount vendor located in Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. He is on the roof deck on the opposite side of the Hold as the elevator, next to the riding trainer, Wind Rider Sabamba. He sells wind riders.
:"In the dark, no one can see you scream…" On April 1st, 2011, Blizzard Entertainment announced an April Fool's Joke, Tomb of Immortal Darkness.
Tol'vir Hieroglyphics is an archaeology quest that grants your group the Tol'vir Secrets buff, increasing damage done to Neferset mobs in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.

The Tol'vir Grave is an object located in the Lost City of the Tol'vir. It starts the quest Tol'vir Hieroglyphics, an archaeology quest that provides a 10% increase to the damage dealt to Neferset mobs while in the instance.

__NOTOC__ Tolliver Houndstooth is a Gilnean worgen druid and quest giver found in Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens. He can be found healing various Wounded Defenders around him with his druidic magics. He is also apparently adept with herbs from the wording of his quests. He requests for adventurers to use his bandages to patch up Wounded Defenders found about Northwatch Hold, and later requesting that they personally kill Karga Rageroar and retrieve his helm for him. It is later revealed that Tolliver as well as several other Gilneans had fallen victim to the Horde intercepting their ship. Taken as prisoners and trophies for the warchief, the worgen fought back against the orcs. Karg
Tol Barad Saboteur is a player vs. player achievement earned for destroying 20 deployed siege engines during battles for Tol Barad.
Tol Barad All-Star is a player vs. player achievement earned for getting 10 honorable kills each at the Ironclad Garrison, Warden's Vigil, and Slagworks during battles for Tol Barad.

Tom along with two another guards guarded the cell of Kerri Hicks. He told her that the Darkmoon Faire left the town but that was not true. The guards were overwhelmed by Lhara's summoned frogs. It is unknown what happened with him after the destruction of Southshore. A guard also referred to Tom as Dirk.

To The Afterlife is an achievement awarded for defeating another player wearing a Day of the Dead costume: While the costume is equipped, players are given a bonus action button that uses one of three abilities at random: This achievement does not have to be earned during Day of the Dead, as the costume is permanent once purchased from Chapman for , but the vendor is only available during the holiday. For an easy method to earn the kill-20 or kill-50 achievements, see the Easy Calavera technique section of the Day of the Dead article.

Tof is a corgi chasing Nom around a small, hidden camp at the waterfalls northeast of Stormwind City. The two of them are the pets of Turp and Roo, who can be found standing nearby.

__NOTOC__ Tomb Approach is a subzone between the Black City and the Tomb of Sargeras proper. It consists of a small cave and the area where Krosus is fought. Horde players do not see the cave section.

Tol Dagor is a dungeon in Battle for Azeroth. It is a prison located in an island east of Tiragarde Sound. Tol Dagor used to be a real prison, but some time ago the Ashvane Trading Company bought it. Now it is Priscilla Ashvane's own personal fortress with scumbags on both sides of the bars.
Tom Powers is a community manager, responsible for posting the latest patch notes of Overwatch on the Overwatch forums.

Tomas Gray once served as a guard in Lordaeron, until Arthas sacked the city and killed King Terenas Menethil II. He was raised into undeath and became Forsaken in service of Sylvanas Windrunner where he eventually served on the Desolate Council. As a member of the council, he was invited to attend the Gathering where he met with Osric Strang; a dear friend from Stormwind who was like a brother to him and with whom they would argue over who made the best armor. He was killed by Sylvanas's rangers during the Gathering while attempting to defect to Alliance lines. His body was buried in the Arathi Highlands by the human attendees that lost friends and family during the bloodshed. __NOTOC__

Toko is a tortollan located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Toko was cornered by the invading sethrak. He was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. Toko was present when riots erupted in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.

Toe Springs can be found in Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island and drop from the following mobs: *Sourback Rider *Scrapbone Trashtosser *Scrapbone Oilspewer *Scrapbone Grunter *Scrapbone Grinder *Scrapbone Flamebelcher
Tollar's Dancing Garments is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tollar's Hidden Flask of Fortification is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Tomb Burster is a spider located in Dredhollow in southern Revendreth. She appears after all of the Crawler Eggs in the area near Funguss have been destroyed. After Tomb Burster has been slain, Funguss can be freed from the webs he's trapped in.
Token of Appreciation is a soulbind trait available on row 8 of Theotar the Mad Duke's soulbind tree. It grants an absorb shield to allies to who use beneficial magic on you.
Tomas Riogain is a human who can be found in various locations. In Dalaran, he provides directions to the city; elsewhere, he serves as a PvP vendor.

__NOTOC__ Toddy Whiskers is a Wildhammer dwarf located in Stormwind City and the Waking Shores. Toddy is from the Hinterlands. According to her grandfather Granpap Whiskers (and he insists the story is true), when she was young Toddy wandered off on her own from camp and got attacked by forest trolls at Jintha'Alor, only to be saved by a newborn gryphon hatchling that had only hatched the day before. The gryphon, who she named Wildfeather, would go on to become her lifelong companion.

Toghusuq Village is a ruined and partially overgrown centaur village located beside the Ohn'ahran River in the eastern Ohn'ahran Plains. It was the home of Clan Toghus before the clan was destroyed by the army of Jhakan Khan. In the aftermath, it was inhabited by feral bakar. Soon after the Windtotem regrouped after being attacked by Clan Nokhud, they took refuge within the village. Sometime later, the Windtotem and Maruuk Centaur held a joint funeral for their shared fallen within the village. In the aftermath, the Windtotem can be found repairing the village.

Tome of Polymorph: Turtle teaches a mage the new ability: Polymorph: Turtle. Learning the spell consumes the tome. This spell is mechanically the same as Polymorph, except the target is transformed into a small turtle instead of a sheep.

__NOTOC__ Toranaku is a nether dragon located inside the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley. Originally, he was supposed to give a quest to kill Or'kaos the Insane upon a player reaching Exalted with the Netherwing in order for him or her to obtain a netherdrake mount; but the idea was replaced with Lord Illidan Stormrage (quest).

Tor'gan's Orb is provided by Tor'gan for Guile of the Raptor (2) to be delivered to Gor'mul. Tor'gan transferred the power and the spirit of the raptors from Raptor Hearts into the orb, imbuing Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor.

__NOTOC__ Torastrasza is a member of the red dragonflight located in Wyrmrest Temple. She is the Majordomo to the Ruling Council of the Wyrmrest Accord, and Alexstrasza's right hand/foreclaw in military matters.

Tome of Polymorph: Black Cat teaches a mage the ability: Polymorph: Black Cat. Learning the spell consumes the tome. This spell is mechanically the same as Polymorph (Rank 4), except the target is transformed into a black cat instead of a sheep.

Tome of Polymorph: Serpent taught a mage the new ability: Polymorph: Serpent. Learning the spell consumes the tome. This spell is mechanically the same as Polymorph (Rank 4), except the target is transformed into a serpent instead of a sheep.

Tony Two-Tusk is a jungle troll pirate found on Fray Island in the Northern Barrens. He also later appears in the Thousand Needles, first as a mob, then again as a quest giver as the Spirit of Tony Two-Tusk. He haunts the adventurer immediately after they kill him during Two-Tusk Takedown. After pestering the adventurer as a ghost for a while, they meet with his ex-wife, Ajamon Ghostcaller and convince her to help bring him back to life. He is eventually revived after The Mad Magus and parts amicably with the player. He later appears in Mount Hyjal as one of many well-known NPCs aiding in the fight against Ragnaros' forces. At some point after the Cataclysm, Admiral Tony Two-Tusk on his boat
Tommy Tinkerspade is a gnome in the Star's Bazaar that sells Herbalism supplies. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Tongue Lash is an ability used by frogs, bandicoons and other pets during a Pet Battle.

Tomma is a Skumblade Saurok. Unlike his more savage brethren, Tomma is contemplative and highly cynical. Having accepted the fact that his race was created by Mogu Flesh-shaping, he looks down on his fellow Skumblade for worshipping the idea that the Saurok are the children of Kros the Devilsaur spirit in spite of the powers the Skumblade Saur-Priests and Skumblade Brutes wield.
Tor'goroth's Tooth is a small island in northern Frostfire Ridge where Tor'goroth resides.

The Toothless Great White is an enormous great white shark located in the Great Sea off the north-eastern coast of Highmountain. A second shark can be found just northeast of Storm's Reach in Stormheim.
The Too Ripe Banana was never made available, and the ID was reused for the Signet of Stormwind (island expedition).

Torcalin Pilgrims are Zandalari trolls who briefly appear in Antul'Mita Plateau in Nazmir.

Tome of the Vanquished is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Torc the Orc was an orc located atop the zeppelin tower in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

Toolbox Trouble is a feat of strength achievement earned by owning the Volatile Self-Driving Toolbox pet from the Recruit A Friend promotion.
Tonk Mines are deployed by Darkmoon Steam Tonks and Steam Tonks.

Tome of Polymorph: Cow would have taught a mage the ability . This spell would have been mechanically the same as Polymorph, but would transform the target into a cow instead of a sheep. The tome and the spell were never implemented.
Torment is a single target damage spell, one of the four abilities of the Voidwalker warlock minion, learned automatically at level 10.
__NOTOC__ Torgos is a two-headed vulture and the lord of the Outland carrion birds. He can be seen flying through the air high above the Bone Wastes in Terokkar Forest.
Torkus Jr. is an ogre mage located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains. He has 10 brothers including Tork and Torki. He tried to ride a Skyguard Nether Ray named Bronco but it escaped from him.
Torque of the Red Dragonflight is an epic necklace for casters, especially for healers.
Tornado Punch is an ability used by Bonkers during a Pet Battle.

Tosan Galaxyfist is one of the Alliance captains that spawn in Ashran. A random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100. He later went on to appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena.
Tormmok is a ogre located at the Destroyed Expedition in Gorgrond.
Torok's Bluff is a tauren village ontop a bluff overlooking the Bloodhunt Highland in Highmountain. It is named after the Bloodtotem chieftain, Torok Bloodtotem.
Torv Dubstomp is a Highmountain tauren quest giver found in the Hall of Chieftains in Thunder Totem.

The Totally Safe Treasure Chest is a treasure chest found on the summit of Reflection Peak in Highmountain. Upon attempting to loot it, Ram'Pag the Treasure Worm emerges from the ground and attacks the player. Upon killing Ram'Pag, the Actually Safe Treasure Chest containing an Offering to Ram'Pag appears on the ground instead.
Torgrul is a drogbar ghost that appeared in front of a adventuring leatherworker at the Lifespring Cavern in Highmountain.
Toska Eaglehorn is a Highmountain tauren located at Swiftwind Post in Drustvar.

The Tortaka tribe is a small tribe of tortollans that formerly inhabited a small fishing village in Darkwood Shoal in Vol'dun, where they survived on fishing and crab hunting. They used to frequently trade with the Zandalari exiles at the Scorched Sands Outpost. Recently, the Stormcoil naga invaded Darkwood Shoal, killing many of the Tortaka and forcing the rest to flee to Tortaka Refuge, where the tortollans were trapped between the naga-controlled ocean in the east and the sethrak-controlled desert in the west with little in the way of food and supplies. When an adventurer arrives, they help the Tortaka investigate the naga's motives and discover that the Stormcoil are searching for the :R
Tortollan Relics drop from Toxic Lurkers and are contained in Ancient Relics and Debris Piles on Mechagon Island.
The Torment in a Jar drops from Dark Inquisitor Xanesh in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
